notes:
Customer profile / shorthand:
- Company: scale-up CX SaaS, heavy multi-tenant chat + knowledge search. Mid-market buyer; cares about latency and predictable cost.
- Trial run: 2 weeks on Hosted API, shipped PoC connectors for chat UI + embedding index.
- Traffic observed (hosted trial logs): baseline ~4-6 QPS, peak spikes up to ~25 QPS (short 3-5min spikes). Typical concurrency observed 8-12, with bursts to ~40 during promo events.
- Token mix (derived from sample logs): chat generation = 62% of requests, avg tokens per chat (input+output) ~320 tokens; embeddings = 24% of requests, avg input tokens ~220 (embedding vector 1536 dim target); reranking/batch scoring = 14%, avg tokens ~110.
- Average token rate (trial week peak): ~6.5k tokens/sec sustained during highest sustained window; peak instantaneous token rate ~22k tokens/sec during spike.
- Latency targets: P95 < 250ms for chat responses, P99 < 400ms acceptable; embeddings throughput target <= 120ms p50.
- Cost sensitivity: wants to keep unit cost < $0.0009/token equivalent for gen-heavy workloads or use committed pricing/Reserved pool.
- Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory, audit logs retention 1 year, keys via KMS, data residency for EU customers (multi-region).
- Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-18): "We need predictability more than raw cheapest price — our product SLAs can't have token-cost surprises. If Dedicated gets us reliable p95 latency and fixed unit pricing, we buy."
- Proposed Dedicated sizing (preliminary ask from AE/SE): start with 2 dedicated GPU nodes (80GB-class) in primary region with autoscale to 4 nodes for peak windows; target per-node concurrency tuned via Redwood Optimize. Customer asked for explicit QPS -> node mapping.
- SE notes (Arjun): will produce two sizing scenarios: "conservative" (headroom for 2x peak) and "efficient" (tight autoscale + KV cache/embedding cache enabled). Need Redwood to run model-run cost sim with their token mix.
- Procurement: procurement lead flagged approval path; wants monthly commit vs annual; indicated internal ARR band $50k-$150k would map to mid-tier commitment.
- Outstanding asks from customer: 1) detailed traffic forecast + node counts mapped to observed trial QPS/concurrency, 2) price models for committed vs burst, 3) security artifacts (SOC2, ISO attachments) and sample audit logs, 4) plan for EU data residency.
- Internal Redwood play: assign infra SME for sizing call, generate two recommended Dedicated SKUs + simulation spreadsheet, forward security pack from compliance folder.
- Staging note: likely to transition from Hosted -> Dedicated if price & sizing align; timeline target end of Q1 (2026-04).
